SAMPLE ANSWER (official):

It helps a business maintain a competitive advantage (any advantage over rivals in cost, reputation or sales) by providing a dependable good that is fit for purpose. Defect-free goods mean fewer returns and warranty repairs, reducing costs and supporting cost leadership. A good reputation is established if the product is dependable, generating repeat sales and making the firm preferred over others.
